[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1r5.1[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Retry transient GitHub SSH publickey denials on git network [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]operations[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A GitHub-side burst of `Permission denied (publickey)` rejections [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]of valid SSH keys no longer aborts agent launches or background git[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]jobs. Launch-blocking and background git network operations retry [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]such denials within a bounded, deadline-aware budget. Genuine [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]credential failures still surface promptly as permanent [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]authentication errors that keep the original stderr: deploy-key [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]refusals, a host with no local SSH credential at all, and a denial [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]that outlasts the budget.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]github_publickey_retry.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/github_publickey_retry.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-1r5.1[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-1r5/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]sase-1r5.1.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase-core credential_unconfirmed verdict for SSH publickey [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]denials[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]core-verdict[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-verdict: in sase-core, classify SSH publickey denials on git and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]git_clone operations as a new non-retryable `credential_unconfirmed` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]verdict whose reason keeps the `authentication` category. Deploy-key [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]refusals stay permanent, the retryability module becomes a facade, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]table and parity tests cover the new verdict.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase pin bump and shared credential-confirmation retry policy[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]credential-retry-policy[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-verdict[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]credential-retry-policy: move sase's sase-core CI pin past the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]classifier change and add the Python wire constant. Add a shared, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]deadline-aware credential-retry tracker with launch and background [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]budgets, an env kill switch, a per-host exhaustion memo, and a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]conservative local-SSH-credential precheck that fails fast when no [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]credential exists.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Adopt credential retries in the SDD store clone[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]sdd-clone-adopt[dim] · [dim][/dim]after credential-retry-policy[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]sdd-clone-adopt: give `clone_sdd_store_to_path` a credential-retry [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]budget separate from its transient schedule, using the launch budget, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]never holding the clone admission permit while sleeping. Prove it with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]an SSH-shim fake GitHub remote that denies N times and then serves a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]real bare repo.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Adopt credential retries in SDD network git and workspace [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]lease fetch[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]network-git-and-lease-adopt[dim] · [dim][/dim]after credential-retry-policy[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]network-git-and-lease-adopt: route publickey denials in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`run_sdd_network_git_with_retries` (agent publication) and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]operational-lease `git fetch` through the shared tracker, replacing the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lease's bespoke one-shot confirmation. Keep `is_credential_failure`, the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ssh-agent hint, and the external mirror's `auth_error` label intact.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Document the auth-retry behavior and record follow-ups[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]docs-and-followups[dim] · [dim][/dim]after sdd-clone-adopt, network-git-and-lease-adopt[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]docs-and-followups: document the retry budgets, kill switch, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fast-fail cases in the service-host and SDD docs. Note the deploy-key [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]marker on sase-167, record proposed follow-ups for network git sites [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that never consult the classifier, and run the shim end to end against [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]both adopted paths.[/#D7D7AF]
